distribution: Original artifacts included with explicit maintainer authorization, 2026-09-27; no retraining or changes to weights.

development_provenance.investigator_supplied: DCA, single-isocenter, C-arm / TrueBeam, Brainlab Elements 4.5 plans
development_provenance.limits: These tags support dynamic rotating single-isocenter plans, but do not independently establish DCA versus VMAT or the TrueBeam machine model. Those descriptors are investigator-supplied. No beam geometry is an inference feature.

variants.near_raw: All-ten-case HGB deployment model; 35-mm target domain.
variants.near_regularized: Near raw followed by Gaussian sigma 1 mm.
variants.near_calibrated: Regularized near model multiplied by hash-bound empirical deployment scalar 1.04; standalone GUI option.
variants.distal: Experimental separately trained extension; blend 30-45 mm in overview_model.py; not wired into standalone GUI.
variants.publication_examples: Cached patient-held-out near HGB, sigma 1 mm and patient-excluding fold-specific calibration; not inference by the all-case deployment model.

warning: Joblib files can execute code. Hashes identify files, not trust. No external clinical validation or full-organ safety claim. No source cohort included.
